context.label: Questions, testimony, and authority

observations.body: Chief priests, scribes, and elders question Jesus; his reply about John’s baptism leaves them caught between unbelief and fear of the crowd.
observations.label: Leaders refuse to answer about John’s authority

observations.body: The passage presents Questioning and refusing an answer as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Questioning and refusing an answer

payload.posture: Read Mark 11:27–33 as one movement in John the Baptist's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
